name: Mekill Depa L'Zile
original_name: ミーキル・デパ・ラジール
source:
Mekill Depa L'Zile is the daughter of the mayor of the great city of L'Zile from the Free Cities Alliance. As such, she represents an important figure as part of the nobilty and the political system of the center.

[spoiler]During the events of the 7th Helman-Leazas War in Rance 03, after the Helman Army expanded their campaign and initiated an invasion over the Free Cities as well, the city of L'Zile was among the first to fall to the invading forces. An army led by [url=/c96942]Henderson Dauntless[/url] then decided to use the city as their base, picking the mansion of the L'Zile family, naturally the wealthiest in the city, as their main headquarters. Her family was promptly captured and imprisoned, but Mekill was instead forced to work for the Helmanian soldiers against her will as a maid, in charge of simple tasks like cleaning and serving as a prostitute in order to provide comfort for the local troops.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Mekill_Depa_L%27Zile]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
